title: Tower Defense Lite
prompt:
Build a tower-defense game on a grid of at least 12x8 cells with one fixed path of 16-60 orthogonally adjacent cells from an edge cell to another edge cell. Gold starts at 100 and lives at 10; a tower costs 50 and fits on any empty non-path cell. Wave n of 10 sends 5 + 2n enemies, one every 30 ticks, which appear at the centre of the first path cell and walk the path at 0.02-0.05 cells per tick; wave 1 enemies have 2 hp, later waves more. Each tower shoots the enemy furthest along the path within 2.5 cells at least every 30 ticks for 1 damage. A kill gives +5 gold and +10 score; an enemy reaching the exit costs a life. 0 lives ends the game with won false; clearing wave 10 wins. Click or tap an empty cell to build; Space or an on-screen button starts the next wave.

Contract (window.Game; implement exactly):
- Game.start(): new game from any phase; phase becomes 'play'
- Game.getState(): {phase:'menu'|'play'|'over', score, won, gold, lives, wave, waves:10, waveActive, cols, rows, path:[{x,y}] (entry first), towers:[{x,y}], enemies:[{x,y,hp}] (cell units; cell (c,r) is centred at (c+0.5, r+0.5))}
- Game.setSeed(n): seed the PRNG behind all randomness (applies at the next start())
- Game.step(n): advance exactly n fixed 1/60 s ticks synchronously
- Game.input.placeTower(x, y): returns false on path, occupied or unaffordable cells
- Game.input.startWave(): returns false while a wave is active
- Game.cellCenter(x, y): canvas point of a cell

Acceptance (checked by Kyora Bench browser tests): path rules, building rules, waves, enemies following the path, leaks, kills, defeat, seeded battles, click, tap and Space.
